execution_policy.parallelism: CIMP-CUR-01 through CIMP-CUR-14 edit disjoint files and have no dependencies. CIMP-CUR-15 waits for every earlier task.
execution_policy.development_inputs: Local baseline 9b4974f86 on codex/current-layout-20261114. That commit is origin/main. GitHub master is 6ad9ac3d1 and remains the default branch. Do not push, force-push, or change the default branch.
execution_policy.implementation_provider_scope: Authorized Grok 4.7 development implementation via llm_router. Offline tests do not disable that provider process. Development permission is not consent to case-data egress.

execution_policy.protected_state: The completed intake, mediator-grounding, GUI collaboration, GUI UX, repository-reorganization, repository-consolidation, module-depth, module-boundaries, and module-seams campaigns, both retained quarantines, submodule pins, and unrelated campaign processes stay untouched. completion_authority stays false. integrations/ipfs_accelerate/improvement_runner.py stays out of the task targets.
execution_policy.upstream_checkout_policy: Use the pinned external checkouts. Do not float pins, recursively initialize submodules, or clone CommonCrawl.
required_evidence: A focused pytest module with positive checks and zero skips
Extracted symbols defined in the sibling and no longer implemented in the owner
Current docs that name modules and files which exist, and that no longer repeat the retired counts or future-UI claims
Locked architecture documents and interface owner lists left byte-for-byte in place
execution_policy.qualification_scope: One focused pytest command per task. Do not run the full historical suite inside the 900-second task budget.
execution_policy.stop_semantics: A test that passes while a named body still lives in the owner, or while a retired documentation claim remains, is a failed task. Do not mark a task complete by hand.
